items.title: ‘Demonic portrayal’: Chennai Mayor Priya objects to Galatta Media reels

items.summary: The Committee, headed by former CEC J.M. Lyngdoh, issued the report dated May 23, 2006; it felt that party-linked student organisations politicise campus elections and split students into rival factions

items.title: Bangladesh's tribunal sentences Awami League leader to death
items.summary: A three-member tribunal led by Justice Nozrul Islam Chowdhury and comprising Justices Md. Manjurul Bashid and Nur Mohammad Shahriar Kabir delivered the verdict
